source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of human-machine collaboration (PDF 189-190).

blocks.text: Human-machine collaboration (insaan aur machine ka mil kar kaam) ka matlab hai masle hal karne ke liye technology ke saath kaam karna. Is mein shamil hai:

items: Using Tools (tools istemal karna): Kaam mein madad ke liye software aur digital tools se faida uthayein. Misal: Students group project ke data ka analysis (ghaur se jaanch) karne ke liye spreadsheet software istemal kar sakte hain.

Combining Skills (skills milana): Behtar results (nateejon) ke liye insaan ki skills ko machine ki capabilities (machine jo kaam kar sakti hai) ke saath milayein. Misal: Complex (mushkil aur bare) data sets ko samajhne ke liye data analysis tools istemal karna, aur faisla karte waqt insaan ki samajh (judgment) lagana.

blocks.prompt: Digital mahaul mein mil kar masle hal karne ki ahmiyat bataiye, aur misalon se samjhaiye ke human-machine collaboration is ko kaise behtar banata hai. (Long question 4)
blocks.explanation: Mil kar kaam karne se alag alag logon ki maharat ek jagah jama hoti hai aur common goal jaldi aur behtar tareeqe se haasil hota hai; digital tools ki madad se log saath kaam kar sakte hain aur research findings aur khayalat aasani se share kar sakte hain (7.6.4.2). Human-machine collaboration mein machine tez aur sahi hisab kitab karti hai aur insaan samajh aur faisla lagata hai: 1) Using tools: students group project ke data ka analysis spreadsheet software se karte hain. 2) Combining skills: data analysis tools complex data sets ko samajhne mein madad dete hain, jab ke faisla insaan ke judgment se hota hai. Is tarah dohraya jane wala aur lamba kaam machine karti hai aur log sochne aur faisle par dhyan dete hain, jis se results behtar hote hain.

items: Human-machine collaboration: tools istemal karna (spreadsheet), skills milana (data analysis tools + insaan ka judgment).
